description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractProvider` that serves as a base for implementing OAuth2 service providers. It includes methods for constructing authorization URLs, handling access tokens, resource owner details, and managing HTTP requests with PSR-7 compliance. The class utilizes traits for common functionalities and provides a framework for specific provider implementations.
